Marcus / Lauren — forwarding a DSR from Brightwell. Key asks: confirmation of controller/processor role for hosted logs, global deletion (KV cache + backups), and an evidence bundle within 30 days.

My read: Brightwell is our customer (controller) and Redwood is processor for hosted inference requests; however, in Dedicated/Private installs role mapping can vary. This tenant is on Hosted; I propose we:

- Confirm processor status to Sam (legal may want precise wording)
- Schedule a deletion job: remove KV cache, purge request logs, scrub any embeddings tied to id 55-100, and note backup retention windows
- Pull evidence: deletion manifest and hashed timestamps; capture the job run id
- Offer a timeline: initial confirmation in 48 hours, deletion within 10 business days (subject to backup retention), evidence delivery within 14 business days

Can Marcus own the ops runbook (steps + logs) and Lauren loop in Legal for the controller/processor wording and any SCC/DPA concerns? I'll coordinate with Brightwell on verification steps.

Aisha
Aisha Rahman
Senior Privacy Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Fwd: Data deletion request for user id 55-100

Aisha — I'll take ops. Proposed checklist:

1) Validate identity token from Brightwell (we need signed confirmation or an MPA ID).
2) Snapshot current state (UUIDs, KV references, embedding ids) — stored in evidence_manifest.csv (attached draft).
3) Run targeted purge: invalidate KV prefix, delete per-user embeddings, mark logs as redacted, initiate backup purge job.
4) Generate deletion manifest with job ids, timestamps, and SHA hashes (for audit).
5) Deliver manifest + redaction screenshots to legal for review before sending to Brightwell.

Estimate: 48-72 hours to validate and prepare, execution in next 5 business days depending on backup cycle. I'll attach the evidence manifest template.

-marcus

Hi Sam — thanks for the submission and the form. Quick update and next steps:

1) Role: For records originating from Brightwell's tenant on our Hosted API, Redwood acts as a processor. We'll provide the deletion and evidence as a processor to your Data Protection Officer.
2) Identity: Please confirm the request using the signed confirmation email from your security contact or via this DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/sign/abc123-dsr
3) Timeline: We will validate the request within 48 hours, schedule the purge within 5 business days after validation, and deliver the evidence package within 14 days of purge completion.
4) What we'll deliver: deletion manifest (job ids + timestamps + SHA hashes), redaction logs, and confirmation of KV cache invalidation.

I've copied our Legal lead, Lauren, and Ops owner, Marcus, who will run the purge and assemble the evidence. Expect an itemized evidence bundle and a Drive link once the job completes.

If Brightwell prefers a more accelerated timeline, let me know and we can evaluate priority processing.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Senior Privacy Program Manager
Redwood Inference
